1. (Currently amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, and an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, wherein __said plurality of light emitting diodes are mounted on said columnar body in a non-uniform spatial distribution__.

2. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open __and said base member comprises a connector structure distinct from said columnar body__.

5. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body __and are mounted at varying axial heights along said columnar body__.

7. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section __and includes at least one internal structural feature__.

8. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 7 wherein at least one diode resides on each face of said columnar body __and said diodes are positioned at different axial locations on said faces__.

9. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 8 wherein one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body __and each fin has a height that varies along its length__.

11. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK __and said material is selected to provide enhanced heat dissipation characteristics beyond standard thermal conductivity values__.

13. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base or a wedge base __and includes an integrated thermal interface__.

16. (Currently amended) A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, said lamp having a general A19 outline, __wherein said light emitting diodes are positioned at non-uniform axial heights within said body__.

17. (Currently amended) A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow body, said body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, cutting said body to a predetermined length, attaching at least one light emitting diode to said body at a specific axial position, and providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diode __with integrated thermal management features__.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said material has a thermal conductivity greater than about 150 W/mK __and is selected for enhanced thermal performance__.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body includes a plurality of integral radially extending fins __with varying cross-sectional dimensions__.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body has substantially straight side walls __and includes internal ribbing structures__.

3. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 further including a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes, __wherein said optic element is integrally formed with said columnar body__.

4. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element includes a phosphor material __and is positioned to provide directional light output__.

12. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 9 including a single optic element disposed between each adjacent fin overlapping said diode, __wherein each optic element is independently positioned__.

15. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element preferentially directs light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body __and includes internal reflective surfaces__.

10. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 9 wherein a single diode resides on each face __and said single diode is positioned at a specific axial location distinct from diodes on adjacent faces__.

6. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are substantially equally disposed between said diodes __and said fins include light-transmissive properties__.

14. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current __and includes thermal management components integrated with said board__.
